store_examples: Laptop, phone, camera, television or other warranty-bearing electronics
Refrigerator, washing machine, air conditioner, furniture or other durable household item
Home repair, maintenance, contractor, utility, district-cooling or service-charge invoice
Flight, hotel, vehicle rental, insurance policy, medical procedure or professional-service document
High-value online order with an invoice, order confirmation, serial number or return/warranty terms
do_not_store_examples: Supermarket basket or low-value convenience-store purchase
Petrol, parking, toll, taxi or public-transport charge
Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, credit-card payment, interest or bank fee
Low-value general retail purchase with no warranty, contract, tax or ownership value

search_strategy.statement_description_missing_product: For each qualifying transaction, search vendor aliases plus amount/currency inside the date buffer. Use matching email/order content to identify the product only after the email is tied by the configured strong facts.

notes: A high-value general purchase is eligible only when it is not in a never-search category. Manual evidence requests always win.
